cadence.name: pentad
cadence.note: every `h` in this file is an AXIS STEP, not a month. The horizon-band keys carry their own day spans for the same reason. `horizon_auc` averages msss_clim over h=1..horizon_steps and is therefore a function of THIS axis's lead sampling; `horizon_auc_daymatched` averages the twelve leads above, which are the monthly archive's, and is the ONLY one of the two that may be compared against an archived corridor AUC.

starts.rule: every k-th start of the holdout year's list, k = len(list)//N, first N — deterministic, keeps the start whose h=1 is the year's first row, and spreads the rest evenly round the seasonal cycle

inputs.doc: E-062-R0 (the FIRST honest roll) - Rolls head-weights-e059-200k-window-s0, the E-059 head trained under --holdout-scope window, through the PROTOCOL-IDENTICAL battery #510 ran on its contaminated twin head-weights-e051-398k-xl144zn-pentad-s0 (same recipe, same codec, same horizon:73 starts:3 longm:36 futm:36, same tensor) - params 206.66M head over the frozen 37.976M run-415 codec (both frozen; NOTHING trains) - stage sroll (eval-only) - data family4_na025_pentad_r2 - arch head 1024x16 K 144 stencil 145 ring spiral; codec 512x12 d_z 32 patch 1 - steps 197428 (= run-415's count, zero training) - resume run-415. WHY: nothing this programme has ever rolled used a clean-pool head. #503, #510 and #513 all rolled heads trained under endpoint_contaminated, so no rolled number in the archive is evidence about forecast skill (Chris, 2026-08-29: 'No need to compare models on the contaminated data. Let's do a proper comparison.'). This is the comparison: one variable changes between #510 and this run - the training pool - and everything else is held to the digit. PRE-REGISTERED READING, per ml/plans/PROTOCOL_RESET.md: the verdict is the SHAPE of skill-vs-lead, not the level. #510's band correlations are 0.511 (h1-18, 5-90 d) / 0.591 (h19-36, 95-180 d) / 0.565 (h37-73, 185-365 d) - flat, and rising from 90 d to 180 d, which is a recall curve. If E-059's profile DECAYS with lead, the clean pool bought genuine forecast skill and the level is then readable. If it is flat too, the leak was never only the pool and the terminal-holdout change (train <=2020, test 2021-2024) is the next necessary move rather than an optional one. Report _trainlon and _holdlon separately, never the blended aggregate (#513: corridor 0.838 trained vs 0.176 held-out). Null ladder alongside: persistence, climatology, damped persistence, and the wind-stress ridge (0.531 at 1 deg, 0.568 at quarter-degree). 441 skill + 438 battery = 879 steps at ~87 s/step = ~21.3 h, inside the 24 h token. Fresh 100 GB box (Vast 49242934 / gpu-box-47898003, 129 GB RAM) - the warm pentad box 49035333 answers resources_unavailable and 48478309's warm cache is the MONTHLY tensor, so this cold-seeds tensor/Z/codec/head from the releases rather than risking the #515 full-disk trap.
